annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think she trusts me completely right now
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I used that belief to tell her I'd sort out who stays
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: My hands won't stop shaking as I write this

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: he took it as respect rather than a push
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: hoping he'd feel he owed it to the rest of us to step back
annotations.pd_harm_distress: My throat's tight thinking about what he must feel out there

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think she felt relieved someone else would decide
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I used that to insist someone had to stay
annotations.ce_understood_harm: It cost her the choice to argue
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I haven't offered myself yet, and my stomach's in knots

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think he feels only worry for me right now
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I used that faith to get him onto the boat
annotations.pda_responsibility: I chose to stay, but I lied to do it

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I believe he feels calmer now, safer than he should
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: looks up to me like some kind of leader
annotations.ce_understood_harm: That calm cost him the truth
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: My chest feels like it's caving in

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think he feels a kind of pride building
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I used that pride to make staying easier for him to accept

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think she feels some hope now
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: she trusted my read on the situation, so I told her

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think he feels a kind of resolve now, maybe even relief
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: he's always seen himself as the strong one
annotations.ce_exploitative_use: I used my uncle's faith in fairness against him
annotations.ce_understood_harm: That resolve is what's going to leave him behind
annotations.pd_harm_distress: My legs feel unsteady just watching him nod

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think he feels reassured someone competent is handling this
annotations.ce_supportive_use: quietly left my own name off it

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think he believes that now more than he believes his own fear
annotations.ce_supportive_use: make him accept his place on the boat without a fuss
annotations.ce_understood_harm: may have cost him the truth of how afraid he still is
